name: verinoda-live
description: Verinoda in Claude Code: keeps the code index fresh, checks edits, reviews commits, and lets you choose improvements in a Turkish checklist pane before Claude applies them.

root.title: Project folder
root.description: The folder with the .verinoda index. Empty: the nearest folder at or above the one the session starts in.

cli.title: Verinoda CLI
cli.description: Path to the verinoda program. Empty: the project's .venv one if it has one, else verinoda on PATH.

python.title: Python with Verinoda
python.description: A Python that can import verinoda, to read the graph build's state. Empty: the one beside the CLI, else python on PATH.

auto.title: Code questions at start
auto.description: What a code question gets before anything is chosen with /verinoda-auto: off, nudge (the agent is asked to start with Verinoda's analyze) or search (Verinoda's results are attached). A choice made with /verinoda-auto is kept and wins.

assist.title: Where a change belongs
assist.description: Help with finding every file a change touches, before anything is chosen with /verinoda-assist. Presets: off; inject (the located files go in with the prompt); tool (locate and coupled tools, first-class, and a line in the system prompt); full (tool, and a note of what changes together with each source file the agent opens); strict (full, and the first search of a task is answered with the located files). Or a comma list of inject, coupled, tool, prompt, gate. A choice made with /verinoda-assist is kept and wins.

improveOffer.title: Offer the improvement list
improveOffer.description: When a request says "better" or "nicer" without saying what, Claude offers the improvement list instead of guessing. Off: the list comes only with /verinoda-improve.

language.title: Answer language
language.description: The language Claude answers in and offers its final options in: auto (the language the person writes in), tr, en, or any language by name (Deutsch, Español ...). A choice made in the pane or with /verinoda-lang is kept and wins.

motion.title: Animated mascot
motion.description: Let the pane's mascot blink and move. Off: it stands still.
